verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents its own bulk operations, but only for specific resources. The API has multi-record endpoints for assigning owners to multiple contacts and marking multiple contacts for 1099 tracking, and the Bank Rules API supports bulk update and delete. The features page also mentions sending bulk collection reminders. There is no evidence of a general bulk or batch mechanism across item types such as invoices, expenses or inventory items. Missing for 10: a general-purpose batch or bulk API across modules, bulk operations for core transaction types, documented batch limits or behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
